text:
Songs of rejoicing and victory

our voices raised on that day

when a royal mortal hand placed on you

the meager laurel of earthly glory.


And today, as you answer your Maker's call

to receive the shining diadem

that the unchanging Supreme Majesty

keeps for the virtuous in the eternal homeland,


our frail human nature strives in vain

to lift its breath to such heights.

It cannot draw, noble Quintana,

even a tender farewell from the grieving lyre!


For though Faith with divine radiance

lights the dense night of the tomb,

and Hope flies to the lofty summit,

showing the path of your triumph,


here, watching your mortal remains

return to earth, we have only,

with the crown Spain inherits from you,

grief in our hearts and tears in our eyes!

translation.title: Songs of Rejoicing and Victory...
